newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Rate on 91-day Bahrain t-bills down at 5.75 pct.
newsitem.headline: Rate on 91-day Bahrain t-bills down at 5.75 pct.

text.p: The average yield at this week's tender for 10 million dinars of 91-day Bahrain treasury bills was down at 5.75 percent from 5.78 percent last week, a spokesman for the Bahrain Monetary Agency said on Monday.
The average price rose to 98.567 from 98.561 and the minimum price accepted was 98.560, up from 98.545 last week.
Banks submitted bids for 27.65 million dinars worth of bills, up from 24.42 million dinars a week ago.
Maturing on August 27, the bills were offered on Monday and will be issued on Wednesday.
